parsed.name: 数据采集模块
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件模块，用于 Zurich Instruments 的 LabOne 环境中，从多个仪器信号源按设定数据率采集、对齐并读取时域或频域数据。它支持连续采集、基于触发条件的突发采集，以及手动触发与采集结果读取，常用于实验测量过程中的数据记录与分析。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software module used in the Zurich Instruments LabOne environment to acquire, align, and read time-domain or frequency-domain data from multiple instrument signal sources at a defined data rate. It supports continuous acquisition, trigger-based burst acquisition, manual triggering, and readout of acquired data for laboratory measurement and analysis workflows.

actions.description_en: Get whether the acquisition has finished.

actions.description: 读取模块已采集的数据，数据可按突发分段返回。
actions.description_en: Read the data acquired by the module; the data may be returned split into bursts.
